subject: IAM role bindings & SCIM sync — private control plane cutover plan
messages:
From: Anika Roy <anika@acme-cloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: itsecurity@acme-cloud.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Mapping IAM role bindings & SCIM sync approach for Private Control Plane

Hi Marcus / Laura / Dev team,

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. As discussed, ACME is preparing to onboard Redwood's Private Control Plane into our VPC next month and we want to align on the identity integration: SAML for admin login + SCIM for group/role sync.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm canonical attribute map (email -> userName, groups -> roles) and how role precedence is evaluated.
- SCIM behavior for group nesting and paging (we have ~18k users).
- Expected SAML IdP metadata format and recommended session durations.
- Network allowlist and mTLS expectations for on-prem SCIM endpoints.

Proposed cutover window: 2026-12-06 02:00–05:00 UTC (low traffic). Can you confirm feasibility and list acceptance tests you need us to run?

Attaching initial SCIM schema from our side. Happy to jump on a short call if that helps.

Thanks,
Anika Roy
Senior IAM Engineer, ACME Cloud
anika@acme-cloud.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Roy <anika@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai, mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mapping IAM role bindings & SCIM sync approach for Private Control Plane

Thanks Anika — good summary. We're aligned on the high-level approach. Quick plan and asks from Redwood: 

1) Role mapping & precedence (draft):
   - SCIM group -> Redwood role (e.g., acme-admins -> redwood:admin, acme-devs -> redwood:developer).
   - If a user is in multiple groups, we evaluate roles by priority: admin > operator > developer > viewer.
   - Service accounts (non-human) will be provisioned as SCIM users with attribute "serviceAccount": true and mapped to a restricted machine role by default.

2) SCIM sync mechanics:
   - We support incremental sync + full reconciliation. For large orgs we recommend incremental polling with changetoken pagination.
   - Please confirm whether ACME's SCIM endpoint supports list-based filter and server-side pagination (RFC 7644).

3) SAML:
   - We accept standard SAML metadata XML or SP-initiated exchange. Idle session TTL defaults to 4 hours but can be overridden per-tenant.

4) Network & on-prem specifics:
   - SCIM collector will reach out to ACME's SCIM endpoint over mutual TLS. We will provide a client cert and CN expectations.
   - Required firewall egress: 34.198.21.0/24 and 52.16.128.0/24 (we'll confirm final CIDRs).

Attachments from our side: scim-schema-proposal.csv and a quick IAM binding diagram (privcp-iam-binding-diagram.png).

Acceptance tests we need ACME to run (short list):
- Create a staging group "acme-redwood-test" -> confirm it results in the "developer" role in a test tenant.
- Create a user, add to group, verify login via SAML with correct roles shown in access logs.
- Verify SCIM incremental update (change one user's email) and validate mapping within 5 minutes.

If that looks good I'll get Mina to draft the rollout checklist and call out any SLA exceptions.

- Marcus
Director, Product Security
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Anika Roy <anika@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-23T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mapping IAM role bindings & SCIM sync approach for Private Control Plane

Adding the attribute map and a couple of implementation notes. See attached attribute-map-v1.tsv (tab-separated). Key points:

- userName -> mapped from user.email (lower-cased, trimmed).
- displayName -> givenName + " " + familyName fallback.
- groups -> group.displayName used for role mapping; we do not accept nested group IDs as role names (we flatten).
- externalId -> used to detect duplicates on first provisioning.

Edge cases / gotchas:
- SCIM paging: for large groups, set pageSize=1000 on initial full sync to avoid timeouts; use delta tokens thereafter.
- Role precedence note: if a user is both "acme-ops" and "acme-viewers" our current policy promotes to ops; this will be configurable but requires an admin setting change (we can flip it during cutover).
- Service account TTLs: machine tokens expire in 30 days and require rotation — we'll need a process for rotation if ACME manages machine users.

Question for ACME: can your SCIM impl return totalResults on list responses? That helps our reconciliation checks.

Thanks,
Laura
Senior Identity Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Anika Roy <anika@acme-cloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-24T14:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mapping IAM role bindings & SCIM sync approach for Private Control Plane

Quick ops note from the deployment side:

- SCIM collector (on-prem) will run inside ACME's VPC as a container behind a private ALB. Collector expects outbound mTLS to the ACME SCIM endpoint only — we will present client cert CN: redwood-scim-client.acme.
- Ports: collector -> endpoint port 443 (HTTPS). Administrative management plane will use port 8443 for debug access (restricted).
- Firewall rules: please allow egress from collector subnets: 10.10.32.0/24 and 10.10.33.0/24 (staging) and 10.10.34.0/24 (prod).
- Time skew: collector requires NTP within 5s for token validation (SAML signature and mTLS cert TTL checks).

Attaching network-allowlist.txt with the CIDRs we currently use. We'll need ACME's firewall team to confirm.

If ACME wants, we can run a smoke test in a sandbox tenant the week of 2026-11-29.

— Dev
Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Anika Roy <anika@acme-cloud.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: itsecurity@acme-cloud.com
Date: 2026-11-29T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Mapping IAM role bindings & SCIM sync approach for Private Control Plane

All good from ACME side — thanks for the detailed plan. A few items to confirm: 

- Our SCIM endpoint supports RFC 7644 paging and returns totalResults. Will set pageSize to 1000 for initial sync.
- Our IdP metadata is available here: https://idp.acme-cloud.com/metadata/sp.xml (valid for 30 days).
- SCIM token (sandbox) created and shared with Mina via secure channel; production token will be rotated on cutover.
- Firewall and mutual TLS: infra confirmed they will allow the collector subnets you listed. We'll add your client cert CN to our trust store.

Acceptance tests:
1) CREATE staging group and confirm role mapping -> scheduled 2026-11-30 09:00 UTC 
2) SCIM incremental update smoke -> 2026-11-30 09:20 UTC 
3) SAML login validation in staging -> 2026-11-30 09:40 UTC

Target cutover: 2026-12-06 02:00–05:00 UTC. We'll open a Jira for the cutover runbook and link to your Atlassian page.

HubSpot deal: deal_89021; Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/cp/ACME-privcp-iam

Thanks everyone — Mina, can you draft the final roll-forward checklist and include an emergency rollback step?

Best,
Anika
Senior IAM Engineer, ACME Cloud
